summary: [spec-fidelity] migrate --revert discards an approval recorded after the migrate, without refusing and without HUMAN_ONLY. check_revert only checks journal files and RevertNote.rebinds comes only from the journal, but the revert restores/removes the whole snapshot. Repro: migrate a repo with an unapproved old brief x and a 0.31 brief y, commit; the human approves y, commit; CANON_ROLE=orchestrator canon migrate --revert --commit exits 0, y loses its Approved: line and .canon/policy.approval.json is removed (a brief created and approved after the migrate is removed the same way). F6: a file changed since (a later approval, edit, review version) is named and refused, and a revert that changes Approved: lines is the human's. Fix: refuse on any restore/remove under changes/ and the review ledger that differs from what the run wrote, and count Approved:/pin changes from the diff.
